# `git_blame`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] git_blame`

Show what revision and author last modified each line of a file. Runs 'git blame' in the working directory.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | yes | Path to the file to blame (required) |
| `line_end` | integer | no | End line number (1-based) to limit blame range |
| `line_start` | integer | no | Start line number (1-based) to limit blame range |
| `revision` | string | no | Revision to blame against (default: HEAD) |
